candidate_selection: Only validation-converged candidate.pt selected by lowest held-out flow loss; never select using task-evaluation scores

fitted_deployment_qualification.cases: Exact original canonical cases/draws in separate qualification output; B8 OpenDrawer full-memory plus B1 CloseFridge full-memory and episode-reset
checks: Actual allocation CUDA/count probe and simulator episodes
Selected fitted checkpoint loaded through actual FlowBridgeCodec/FlowBridgeMotor and unchanged native expert
Fitted KV affects all18 real prefix-cache layers; fitted velocity residual applied at every denoising step
First query has zero previous episodes in both modes; full mode retains only prior feedback and episode mode clears at the boundary
Exact action-draw/query chronology, mapped binary controls, prior-history receipts and no future tokens
Frozen expert and selected policy hashes unchanged; deployment constructs no optimizer and takes zero SGD steps
Raw draws/commands/feedback/frames audited through frozen-steering path; older direct-action audit is not substituted

readout.unchanged_anchors: Only hash-bound original-native and fixed130-native controls on the original cases/draws; verify identities during fitted qualification
readout.hot_reservation_status: Provisional; measure fitted qualification wave size and archival latency, then reserve a bounded double buffer before any main readout
readout.cold_archival: Independent complete-wave raw/frame audit, SHA-verified cold readback and stable original paths; preserve every incomplete or unaudited wave

budget.admission: No readout GPU allocation until actual released-fit reservations plus measured readout/qualification costs fit150; complete8-model54.1GPUh readout already exceeds remaining150 cap and requires new direct human budget authorization unless verified measured cost changes that conclusion

shared_storage.admission: Reconcile current actual bytes and remaining reservations with owning chats; do not count already-consumed bytes twice. No new rollout writers admitted by this plan.
